kind: independent source-only causal change evidence DEV
goal: Falsify whether actual observed action-conditioned causal evidence can reactivate a retained initial learned causal model after a hidden A->B->A change, while beating a well-trained cumulative/discounted native causal model and a strong conventional Bayesian online changepoint model.
precommitted_warm_reference: One CKAD42 exact NativeInterventionRelations is trained on first 64 authentic public events then frozen as A reference. The 64-episode calibration period is GIVEN as stable by the existing synthetic task's family; this is a structural task advantage, not unknown-boundary zero-shot transfer. Continual adaptive CKAD42 exact NativeInterventionRelations trains on ALL events. Neither uses true hidden phase labels or future consequences.
native_reference: Unmodified Yggdrasil NativeEpisodeExperience(repair=True), 48 warm source events then begin_stream; trained on same real observed synthetic events throughout.

candidate.mode: source-conditioned Bayesian soft retrieval, no hard switch
candidate.mechanism: At each public transition/terminal consequence, BEFORE training, record the log likelihood ratio that the previously frozen A source predicts this paired event against the continuously trained discount93 causal learner. Maintain previous 12 witnessed ratios; require observed variety in both first and second interventions (both binary values represented in the window), else use adaptive learner alone. At subsequent forecast, evidence w_A = logistic(clip(sum(last12 log(A_event_prob/adaptive_event_prob)), -8, 8)), with equal 1:1 prior odds. Blend stage-1 predictions with w_A. After observed transition but before terminal, condition mixture weight using each model's transition probability for that actually observed next_state, and blend terminal predictions using updated w_A. All evidence from previously witnessed actions and consequences, no private environment regime, label or future reward.

frozen_config.trained_component: source-based CKAD42 exact causal relations short discount=.93

ablations: action-masked learned relations from same source

conventional_bocpd.prior: independent Beta(1,1) binary transition and terminal outcome cells conditioned on observed (ctx, first_action) and (ctx, first_action, observed_next_state, second_action)
conventional_bocpd.inference: Bayesian online changepoint: previous run posterior with constant hazard; after observing each genuine public transition and terminal outcome, exact paired Bernoulli posterior predictive likelihood of that row updates each run-length state; growth and newly reset components updated on the same row; cap 48 states and renormalize. First-stage forecast averages over run posterior; terminal stage conditions run probabilities on actually observed next_state, not terminal reward. Independent fully trained source-only strong control.

additional_fitted_controls: CKAD42 causal full, short discount93 and prequential dual Hedge
original Beta full/window12/window24/window48/discount85/discount95 and fitted prequential Hedge
source_data: Exact existing CKAD39 genuine stochastic A/B/A simulator with same public action draws for all arms and 2 worlds per seed; hidden labels only evaluator. No new causal family or genuinely unfamiliar action identity within DEV. A separate fixture-only action-symbol bijection test probes encoding equivariance, NOT unfamiliar action transfer.
metrics: Two-stage prequential combined Brier phase lateB, early_returnA, late_returnA and pooled lateB+lateReturn. Strict original source and learned snapshot identity, cold exactness, no future-stage mutation, no duplicate or conflicting source. Count no-diversity windows, within-window observed intervention diversity, evidence posterior and per-world update CPU/wall with extra work.

frozen_scientific_dev_stop.decision: If ANY frozen threshold fails => DEV_NO_GO, stop. Otherwise DEV_FEASIBLE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC. No second tuning pass on scored original seeds. No automatic held pilot/primary first-use.

qualification: First source commit preregisters hypothesis/seeds/constants/controls/stop. Then separately pure fixture unit tests, then ONE development cohort on two OS at exactly same source SHA; in-repo original receipts preserve negative outcomes, performance, checkpoint hashes, incomparable raw platform floats; no scientific pass without independent unfamiliar-family held first use and full repo final regression on owner accepted candidate.
